<style>
.bottom-banner {
background-color: #fff;
position: fixed;
bottom: 40px;
z-index: 9999;
width: calc(100% - 30px);
margin-left: 15px;
box-shadow: 0px 0px 16px #888888;
display: flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content: space-around;
}

.bottom-banner-css-version-v2{
border-left: 15px solid #ec008c;
}
.bottom-banner-css-version-v3{
border-left: 15px solid #35c8f5;
}
.bottom-banner-css-version-v2 .bottom-banner__button{
background-color: #35c8f5;
}
.bottom-banner-css-version-v3 .bottom-banner__button{
background-color: #ec008c;
}

.bottom-banner--hidden {
display:none;
}

.bottom-banner__message {
padding: 1em;
float: left;
font-size: 12px;
line-height: 1.4;
}

.bottom-banner__dismiss-icon {
float: right;
padding:10px;
color: #d1d1d1;
cursor: pointer;
align-self: flex-start;
}
.bottom-banner__dismiss-icon:hover {
color: #333333;
}

.bottom-banner__button, .bottom-banner__button:hover, .bottom-banner__button:visited, .bottom-banner__button:active {
float:right;
font-size: 16px;
line-height: 1.6;
border-radius: 4px;
padding: 7px 15px 7px 15px;
color: #fff !important;
transition: all .25s linear;
text-decoration: none;
}
.bottom-banner__button:hover {
color: #fff;
}

.cookie-modal--hidden {
display: none;
position: fixed;
z-index: 10001;
left: 0;
top: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
overflow: auto;
}

.cookie-modal-content {
background-color: var(--color-surface1);;
margin: 20% auto;
padding: 20px;
width: 40%;
box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 6px 20px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.19);
}

.cookie-modal-content h3 {
display: inline-block;
}

.cookie-modal-css-version-v3 {
padding-top: 16px;
}

.cookie-modal_switch .switch{
display: inline-block;
float: right;
margin-top: 30px;
width: 60px;
}
.switch {
position: relative;
display: inline-block;
width: 60px;
height: 26px;
}

.switch input {
opacity: 0;
width: 0;
height: 0;
}

.slider {
position: absolute;
cursor: pointer;
top: 0;
left: 0;
right: 0;
bottom: 0;
background-color: #8492A6;
-webkit-transition: .3s;
transition: .3s;
}

.slider:after {
content: "Off";
position: absolute;
top: 50%;
right: 11px;
transform: translateY(-50%);
color: #fff;
font-family: helvetica;
font-weight: bold;
font-size: 13px;
}

.slider:before {
position: absolute;
content: "";
height: 20px;
width: 20px;
left: 3px;
bottom: 3px;
background-color: white;
-webkit-transition: .3s;
transition: .3s;
}

input:checked + .slider {
background-color: #00853C;
}

input:disabled + .slider {
cursor: no-drop;
background-color: #C2C7D1;
}

input:disabled + .slider:before {
background-color: #DFE2E7;
}

input:focus + .slider {
box-shadow: 0 0 5px #2196F3;
}

input:checked + .slider:before {
-webkit-transform: translateX(33px);
-ms-transform: translateX(33px);
transform: translateX(33px);
}

input:checked + .slider:after {
content: "On";
right: auto;
left: 11px;
}

/* Rounded sliders */
.slider.round {
border-radius: 26px;
width: 60px;
}

.slider.round:before {
border-radius: 50%;
}
.close {
float: right;
font-size: 20px;
font-weight: bold;
line-height: 18px;
color: var(--color-grayscale1);
text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #ffffff;
opacity: 0.2;
filter: alpha(opacity=20);
}
.close:hover {
color: var(--color-grayscale1);
text-decoration: none;
opacity: 0.4;
filter: alpha(opacity=40);
cursor: pointer;
}
</style>

<script type="text/javascript" nonce="">

// Google analytics function to send events via gtag.js
function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}

initializeOldGoogleAnalytics();
initializeNewGoogleAnalytics();

window['ga-disable-UA-31040388-1'] = true;

var gdprCookie = getCookie("gdpr_accepts_cookies");

if (gdprCookie != undefined) {
gdprCookie == "true" ? gdprCookie = true : gdprCookie = false;
};

var gdprBanner = document.getElementById("gdpr-notification");
var gdprBannerDissmissButton = document.getElementById("gdpr-notification-dismiss-button");
var gdprLoggedIn = true;
var gdprAccountAcceptsCookies = true;

var cookieModal = document.getElementById("cookie-modal");
var cookieModalClose = document.getElementById("cookie-modal-dismiss");
var cookieModalSwitch = document.getElementById("cookie-modal-input");

var bannerLinkPreferences = document.getElementById("banner-link-preferences");

bannerLinkPreferences.onclick = function () {
cookieModal.style.display = 'block';
hideGDPRBanner();
}

function setGDPRCookie(value, expirationInDays) {
var date = new Date();
date.setTime(date.getTime() + expirationInDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); //convert to milleseconds
var expires = "expires="+ date.toUTCString();
document.cookie = "gdpr_accepts_cookies=" + value + ";" + expires + ";path=/"+ ";domain=.roll20.net";
}

function getCookie(cname) {
var name = cname + "=";
var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
for(var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
var c = ca[i];
while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
c = c.substring(1);
}
if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
}
}
return undefined;
}

function checkGdprStatus() {
if (gdprLoggedIn == true) {
checkAccountGdprCookieSettings();
} else {
checkPublicGdprCookieSettings();
}
}

function checkAccountGdprCookieSettings() {
var cookieExists = getCookie("gdpr_accepts_cookies");

switch(cookieExists){
case "true":
acceptCookies();
break
case "false":
denyCookies();
break
case undefined:
showGDPRBanner();
acceptCookies();
break
}
}

function checkPublicGdprCookieSettings() {
console.log('Not logged in - checking cookie GDPR status');
if (gdprCookie == undefined) {
console.log("No GPDR Cookie Detected");
showGDPRBanner();
acceptCookies();
} else if (gdprCookie == true){
console.log("GDPR Cookie Detected");
acceptCookies();
}
}

// Options object for google analytics based on the current account
function getAnalyticsConfigOptions() {
return {'cookieDomain': 'auto', 'userId': '228176'}
}

// Not impacted by GDPR - just connects our account
// Remove after everything has been switched to gtag
function initializeOldGoogleAnalytics() {
ga('create', 'UA-31040388-1', getAnalyticsConfigOptions());
}

// Not impacted by GDPR - just connects our account
function initializeNewGoogleAnalytics() {
window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

gtag('js', new Date());

// Universal analytics
gtag('config', 'UA-31040388-1', { ...getAnalyticsConfigOptions(), send_page_view: false });
// Google Analytics 4
gtag('config', 'G-SZLSVQPSWG', { ...getAnalyticsConfigOptions(), send_page_view: false });
}

function turnOnGoogleAnalytics() {
window['ga-disable-UA-31040388-1'] = false;
ga('send', 'pageview');
if(window.dataLayer) {
dataLayer.push({'event': 'optedIn'});
}
}

var showGDPRBanner = function () {
gdprBanner.classList.remove("bottom-banner--hidden");
}

var hideGDPRBanner = function () {
gdprBanner.classList.add("bottom-banner--hidden");
}

var updateUserAccount = function(account_id, value) {
var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
// need to get the below working for marketplace, compendium, landing (only works for app)
xhr.open("PATCH", '/accounts/'+account_id, true);
xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8');
var cookieValue = "account[gdpr_accepts_cookies]=" + value;
xhr.send(cookieValue);
}

var acceptCookies = function () {
setGDPRCookie(true, 365);

turnOnGoogleAnalytics();
turnOnDataDogRUM();
// hideGDPRBanner();
document.getElementById("cookie-modal-input").checked = true;
}

var denyCookies = function () {
setGDPRCookie(false, 365);
}

var toggleCookie = function () {
var switchChecked = document.getElementById("cookie-modal-input").checked;
setGDPRCookie(switchChecked, 365);

updateUserAccount(228176, switchChecked)
}

var showCookieModal = function (){
cookieModal.style.display = "block";
}
var closeCookieModal = function (){
cookieModal.style.display = "none";
}

if (gdprCookie == true || gdprAccountAcceptsCookies == true){
document.getElementById("cookie-modal-input").checked = true;
}

gdprBannerDissmissButton.addEventListener("click", hideGDPRBanner);
cookieModalClose.addEventListener("click", closeCookieModal);
cookieModalSwitch.addEventListener("click", toggleCookie);

checkGdprStatus();

function vttSampleRate() {
const sampleRate = 0;
if (sampleRate > 5) return sampleRate;
return 5;
}

function experiment({ chatTech }) {
const experimentsEnabled =false;
return experimentsEnabled && chatTech === 'simple-peer';
}

function staging({ hostName }) {
return hostName === 'roll20staging.net';
}

function ddSampleRate(opts) {
if (experiment(opts)) return 100;
return staging(opts) ? 100 : vttSampleRate();
}

function turnOnDataDogRUM () {
var tmplMeta = {
chatTech: '',
hostName: 'roll20.net',
version: '24.2.7.1',
};
var sampleRate = ddSampleRate(tmplMeta);
window.DD_RUM && window.DD_RUM.init({
applicationId: '95ddf222-5b92-4a62-803a-185cdd723c8b',
clientToken: 'pub3fb1f7cf273c5d345be974e50be0dfda',
site: 'datadoghq.com',
service:'d20app',
sampleRate,
trackInteractions: true,
version: tmplMeta.version,
});
}
</script>



<script type="text/javascript">
// Sets a browser cookie, but only allows true or false flags
function setCookie(name, value, expirationInDays) {
let date = new Date();
date.setTime(date.getTime() + expirationInDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); //convert to milleseconds
const expires = `expires=${date.toUTCString()}`;
if (value == true || value == false) {
document.cookie = `${name}=${value};${expires};path=/;domain=.roll20.net`;
} else if (name == "subscriptionGiftPurchaseInfo"){
// it is a gift subscription and we need some actual values
let amount = value.substring(
value.indexOf("=") + 1,
value.lastIndexOf("|")
)
let giftToId = value.split('|giftToId=')[1];
document.cookie = `subscriptionGiftPurchaseInfo=true|amount=${amount*100}|giftToId=${giftToId};${expires};path=/;domain=.roll20.net`;
}else {
return undefined;
}
}

// Gets a browser cookie value
function getCookie(cname) {
let name = cname + '=';
let ca = document.cookie.split(';');
for(let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
let c = ca[i];
while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
c = c.substring(1);
}
if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
}
}
return undefined;
}

function checkCookieFlag(name) {
let flag = getCookie(name);
if (flag != undefined) {
flag == 'true' ? flag = true : flag = false;
}
return flag;
}
</script>

<h1>

</h1>
<hr>

<form id="settingsform" action="/campaigns/savesettings/16707527" method="post">
<p style='font-size: 1.2em; margin-top: 10px;'>
<strong>Allow public access to this game?</strong>

<label style="display: inline-block; width: auto;"><input type="radio" name="publicaccess" value="false" checked=&#39;true&#39; /> No</label>
</p>
<p>
<em>Allows anyone to view your game details page, public journal entries (marked for "All Players"), and read game forums. Only those you have invited as players will be able to join the game itself, read the chat archive, or post in the forums.</em>
</p>

<p class='selectable expandable background_image'>
<strong style='font-size: 1.2em;'>

</p>

function flippyTriangle($container) {
var $flippyTriangle = $container.find('.flippy-triangle');
var isOn = $flippyTriangle.hasClass('on');
$flippyTriangle.html(isOn ? '&#x25B8;' : '&#x25BE;').addClass(isOn ? 'off' : 'on').removeClass(isOn ? 'on' : 'off');
}

$('.compendiumsettings').on('click', function(e) {
$('.compendiumoptions').toggleClass('hidden');
flippyTriangle($('.compendiumsettings'));
});

$(`.compendiumoptions`).on(`change`, `select[name="compendium_override"]`, (e) => {
let selected_value = $(e.target).val();
let default_name = "None (Character Sheet Default)";
if(compendium_book_list[sheet_compendium_default]) {
default_name = `${compendium_book_list[sheet_compendium_default].name} (Character Sheet Default)`;
}
$(e.target).find(`option[value=""]`).html(default_name);
if(selected_value === '') {
selected_value = sheet_compendium_default;
}

if(previous_selected_value !== selected_value) {
const $target = $(".compendium-expansions-list");
$target.html('');

if(selected_value !== '' && compendium_expansion_list[selected_value]) {
$(".allowed-expansions").show();
_.each(compendium_expansion_list[selected_value], (expansion) => {
$target.append(generateExpansionToggle(expansion))
});
} else {
$(".allowed-expansions").hide();
}
previous_selected_value = selected_value;
}

updateSelectDeselectAllButtons();
});

$("#compendiumSharingSlots").on("click", ".cancel-sharing", function () {
var $thisButton = $(this);
var campaignId = $thisButton.data("campaign-id");

if (confirm($thisButton.data("remove-message"))) {
$.post("/campaigns/removecompendiumsharing/" + campaignId, function () {
location.reload();
});
}
});

const updateSelectDeselectAllButtons = () => {
const selected_system = $('select[name="compendium_override"]').val();
if (selected_system == '' && !compendium_book_list[sheet_compendium_default]) {
$('#select_deselect_all_div').hide();
} else {
$('#select_deselect_all_div').show();
}
};

const generateExpansionToggle = (expansion) => {
const checked = currently_blocked_expansions.includes(expansion.id) ? "checked" : "";
const owned = owned_expansion_ids.includes(expansion.id);
const sharing = $(`#compendium-sharing-yes`).prop('checked');
const owned_span = owned ? `<span>Owned</span>` : `<span><a href="${expansion.url}" target="_blank">Purchase</a></span>`;
let this_translation = "";
if(owned && sharing) {
this_translation = `Available and you own. Will be shared with other players.`;
} else if (owned) {
this_translation = `Available and you own. Will not be shared with other players.`;
} else if (checked) {
this_translation = `Not Available.`;
} else {
this_translation = `Available for those who own.`;
}
return `<div class="expansion">
<input type="checkbox" id="allow-expansion-${expansion.id}" data-id="${expansion.id}" name="allow-expansion-${expansion.id}" ${checked}>
<label class="${owned ? `owned ` : `unowned `} showtip tipsy-w" for="allow-expansion-${expansion.id}" title="${this_translation}">
<strong>${expansion.title}</strong>
<em>${expansion.author}</em>
${owned_span}
</label>
</div>`;
};

const updateSharingSlotDisplay = (sharing_slot_json) => {
const $sharing_slot_container = $("#compendiumSharingSlots");
const remove_confirm_string = `Are you sure you want to remove compendium sharing from "{{0}}"?`;
$sharing_slot_container.html("");
_.each(sharing_slot_json, (sharing_slot) => {
if(_.isEmpty(sharing_slot)) {
$sharing_slot_container.append(
`<div class="shared-compendium available">
<span class="shared-compendium-name">
Compendium Sharing Slot Available
</span>
</div>`
);
} else if (sharing_slot.id === campaign_id) {
$sharing_slot_container.append(
`<div class="shared-compendium">
<span class="shared-compendium-name">
${sharing_slot.name}
</span>
<div class="hint">(this game)</div>
</div>`
)
} else {
$sharing_slot_container.append(
`<div class="shared-compendium cancel-sharing" data-campaign-id="${sharing_slot.id}" data-remove-message='${remove_confirm_string.replace('{{0}}', sharing_slot.name)}'>
<span class="pictos">*</span>
<span class="shared-compendium-name">
${sharing_slot.name}
</span>
</div>`
)
}
})
};

const updateTipsForSources = () => {
const sharing = $(`#compendium-sharing-yes`).prop('checked');
const sharing_translation = `Available and you own. Will be shared with other players.`;
const not_sharing_translation = `Available and you own. Will not be shared with other players.`;
const not_available_translation = `Not Available.`;
const available_not_owned_translation = `Available for those who own.`;
if(sharing) {
$('.compendium-sources-key p .sharing-key').show();
$('.compendium-sources-key p .not-sharing-key').hide();
$('.compendium-expansions-list div label.owned').attr('title', sharing_translation);
} else {
$('.compendium-sources-key p .sharing-key').hide();
$('.compendium-sources-key p .not-sharing-key').show();
$('.compendium-expansions-list div label.owned').attr('title', not_sharing_translation);
}
$('.compendium-expansions-list input.unowned + label').attr('title', available_not_owned_translation);
$('.compendium-expansions-list input:checked + label').attr('title', not_available_translation);
}

$(`a.save-compendium-settings`).on('click', () => {
const blocked_expansion_ids = [];
const compendium_override = $(`select[name="compendium_override"]`).val();
const sharecompendiums = $(`#compendium-sharing-yes`).prop('checked');
$(`.compendium-expansions-list input[type=checkbox]:checked`).each(function() {
blocked_expansion_ids.push($(this).data("id"));
});
$.post(`/campaigns/savecompendiumsettings/16707527`, {
blocked_expansion_ids: blocked_expansion_ids,
compendium_override: compendium_override,
sharecompendiums: sharecompendiums
}, (data) => {
try {
const sharing_slot_data = JSON.parse(data);
updateSharingSlotDisplay(sharing_slot_data);
$(`.compendiumoptions .alert-warning`).hide();
$(`.compendiumoptions .alert-success`).show();
} catch(e) {
$(`.compendiumoptions .alert-warning`).show();
$(`.compendiumoptions .alert-success`).hide();
}
});
});

$('#select_all_expansions_button').on('click', () => {
const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.expansion input[type=checkbox]')
checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => checkbox.checked = false)
});

$('#deselect_all_expansions_button').on('click', () => {
const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.expansion input[type=checkbox]')
checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => checkbox.checked = true)
});

$(`.compendiumoptions`).on('click', () => {
$(`.compendiumoptions .alert-warning`).hide();
$(`.compendiumoptions .alert-success`).hide();
});

$('#compendium-sharing-yes, #compendium-sharing-no, .compendium-expansions-list').on('click', () => {
updateTipsForSources();
});

$(document).ready(() => {
const initial_sharing_slots = [{},{},{},{},{}];
updateSharingSlotDisplay(initial_sharing_slots);
updateTipsForSources();
updateSelectDeselectAllButtons();
// If this is an anchor link to the compendium settings section,
// We need to open trigger a click on the header to expand that section
const url = window.location.href.split('#').slice(-1)[0].split('?')[0];
if (url === 'compendiumsettings') {
$("#compendiumsettings").trigger('click');
}
});

</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
async function getCharsheet(shortname, props = []) {
try {
const result = await $.ajax({
url: `https://api.charactersheet.production.roll20preflight.net/graphql`,
type: 'POST',
data: {query:`{characterSheet(shortname: "${shortname}"){${props.join()}}}`},
timeout: 3000,
error: function() {
return {}
}
});

return result.data.characterSheet;
} catch(error) {
console.log(error);
return {};
}
}
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">

window.UNSAVEDCHANGES = false;

let originalSelectedSettings = [];

const updateSheetInfo = (sheet) => {
const preview_selector = `#sheet-previews .preview[data-shortname=${sheet.shortname}]`;
sheet_compendium_default = sheet.compendium || "";

$("#sheet-error").hide();

if(sheet.shortname == "custom") {
$("#customsheet-editor").show();
$("#sheet-previews").hide();
}
else {
$("#customsheet-editor").hide();
$("#sheet-previews").show();
$("#sheet-previews .preview").hide();

if($(preview_selector).length > 0) {
$(preview_selector).show();
}
else {
// USER OPTIONS
if (sheet.translation) i18n.translator.add({values: sheet.translation});

var opthtml = getSheetPreview(sheet);
$("#sheet-previews").append(opthtml);
$(preview_selector).show();
};
}
$(`select[name="compendium_override"]`).trigger(`change`);
}

const getSheetPreview = (sheet) => {
var rescuevals = {};
var $preview = $(`<div class='preview' data-shortname='${sheet.shortname}'>`);
var opthtml = '';
sheet.jsoninfo = sheet.jsoninfo || {};
sheet.longname = sheet.longname || 'Test Sheet';
$preview.append(`<h3>${sheet.longname}</h3>`);
$preview.append(`<p><strong>Authors:</strong>${sheet.authors}</p>`);
$preview.append(`<img src='${sheet.previewImage}'>`);
$preview.append(`<div class='instructions'>${sheet.instructions}</div>`);
sheet.userOptions = _.without(sheet.userOptions, null);
if(sheet.userOptions && sheet.userOptions.length > 0) {
opthtml += `<div class='defaultsheetsettingscontainer'><h4>Default Sheet Settings</h4>`;
_.each(sheet.userOptions, function(opt) {
opthtml += `<div class='useroptions' style='margin-bottom:5px;'><span style='font-weight:bold; margin-right: 5px;'>${i18n(opt["displaytranslationkey"], opt["displayname"])}</span>`;
if(opt.type === "text") {
if(sheetsettings[opt["attribute"]] != undefined) {
opthtml += `<input type='text' data-name='${opt.attribute}' value='${sheetsettings[opt.attribute]}'>`;
}
else if(opt["default"] && opt["default"] != "") {
opthtml += `<input type='text' data-name='${opt.attribute}' value='${opt.default}'>`;
}
else {
opthtml += `<input type='text' data-name='${opt.attribute}'>`;
}
}
if(opt.type === "number") {
if(sheetsettings[opt["attribute"]] != undefined) {
opthtml += `<input type='number' data-name='${opt.attribute}' value='${sheetsettings[opt.attribute]}'>`;
}
else if(opt["default"] && opt["default"] != "") {
opthtml += `<input type='number' data-name='${opt.attribute}' value='${opt.default}'>`;
}
else {
opthtml += `<input type='number' data-name='${opt.attribute}'>`;
}
}
if(opt.type === "select" && opt["options"] && opt["options"].length > 0) {
opthtml += `<select data-name='${opt.attribute}'>`;
_.each(opt["options"], function(selectoption, i) {
if(selectoption.indexOf("|") > -1) {
var slabel = selectoption.split(/\|(.+)/)[0];
var svalue = selectoption.split(/\|(.+)/)[1];
// HACK TO PREVENT DECODING OF CURLY BRACERS
if(svalue && (svalue.indexOf("&#123") > -1 || svalue.indexOf("&#125") > -1)) {
svalue = svalue.replace(/&#123/g,"@@123").replace(/&#125/g,"@@125");
rescuevals[opt["attribute"]] = i;
}
}
else {
var slabel = selectoption;
var svalue = selectoption;
}
if(!slabel) {slabel = ""};
if(!svalue) {svalue = ""};
if(opt["optiontranslationkeys"] && opt["optiontranslationkeys"][i]) {
slabel = i18n(opt["optiontranslationkeys"][i], slabel);
}
if(sheetsettings[opt["attribute"]] && sheetsettings[opt["attribute"]] === svalue) {
opthtml += `<option value='${svalue}' selected='selected'>${slabel}</option>`;
}
else if(!sheetsettings[opt["attribute"]] && opt["default"] && opt["default"] === svalue) {
opthtml += `<option value='${svalue}' selected='selected'>${slabel}</option>`;
}
else {
opthtml += `<option value='${svalue}'>${slabel}</option>`;
}
});
opthtml += "</select>";
}
if(opt.type === "checkbox" && opt["value"]) {
if(sheetsettings[opt["attribute"]] != undefined && sheetsettings[opt["attribute"]] === opt["value"]) {
opthtml += `<input type='checkbox' data-name='${opt.attribute}' value='${opt["value"]}' checked='checked'>`;
}
else if(sheetsettings[opt["attribute"]] === undefined && opt["checked"] && opt["checked"] === "checked") {
opthtml += `<input type='checkbox' data-name='${opt.attribute}' value='${opt["value"]}' checked='checked'>`;
}
else {
opthtml += `<input type='checkbox' data-name='${opt.attribute}' value='${opt["value"]}'>`;
}
}

if(opt["description"] && opt["description"] != "") {
opthtml += `<span class='sheetsettingdescription'>${i18n(opt["descriptiontranslationkey"], opt["description"])}</span>`;
}

opthtml += "</div>";
});
opthtml += "</div>";
$preview.append(opthtml);

// HACK TO PREVENT DECODING OF CURLY BRACERS
_.each(rescuevals, function(v, k) {
var rescueoption = $preview.find("*[data-name=" + k + "] option:eq(" + v + ")");
rescueoption.val(rescueoption.val().replace(/@@123/g,"&#123").replace(/@@125/g,"&#125"));
if(sheetsettings[k] && sheetsettings[k] === rescueoption.val()) {
rescueoption.prop({selected:true});
}
});
}

return $preview;
};

$(".campaign_settings").on("change", "*[data-name]", function() {
window.UNSAVEDCHANGES = true;
});

$("#save-changes-button").on("click", function( event ) {
const campaignID = "16707527";
let newSheetSettings = {};

$("#save-changes-button").html("Processing, please wait");
$("#save-changes-button").addClass("disabled");

const findObjectWith = matchingTerm => originalSelectedSettings.find(original => original.attribute === matchingTerm)

_.each($("*[data-name]:visible"), function(option) {
const jQueryData = {
checked: $(option).prop("checked"),
name: $(option).data("name"),
inputTypeCheckbox: $(option).is("input[type=checkbox]"),
value: $(option).val()
}

const originalSelected = findObjectWith(jQueryData.name) || {}

if (jQueryData.inputTypeCheckbox) {
const originalValue = originalSelected.checked && originalSelected.checked === "checked" ? originalSelected.value : "";
const newValue = jQueryData.checked ? jQueryData.value : "";

if(newValue != originalValue || sheetsettings[jQueryData.name] != undefined) {
newSheetSettings[jQueryData.name] = newValue;
};
} else {
if ((originalSelected.default != jQueryData.value || sheetsettings[jQueryData.name] != undefined) && (jQueryData.value != '' || originalSelected.default)) {
newSheetSettings[jQueryData.name] = jQueryData.value;
};
}
});

$.post(`/campaigns/save_game_defaults/${campaignID}/sheet`, {defaults: JSON.stringify(newSheetSettings)}, function(data) {
window.UNSAVEDCHANGES = false;
$("#settingsform").submit();
})
});

window.onbeforeunload = function() {
if(window.UNSAVEDCHANGES) {
return "You have unsaved changes pending. If you leave this page, they will be lost. Hit the Save Changes button at the bottom of the screen if you want to save your changes.";
}
};

$("select[name=charsheettype]").on("change", function() {
$("#customsheet-editor").hide();
$("#sheet-previews").show();

let shortname = $(this).val();
if (['none', 'custom'].includes(shortname)) {
updateSheetInfo({shortname: shortname});
return;
}

getCharsheet(shortname, [
'compendium',
'shortname',
'longname',
'userOptions',
'authors',
'previewImage',
'instructions',
`translation(language: "${locale}")`
]).then((sheet) => {
if (_.isEmpty(sheet)) {
$("#sheet-error").show();
} else {
originalSelectedSettings = sheet.userOptions || [];
updateSheetInfo(sheet)
}
});
});

$('select[name=charsheettype]').change();

</script>

<script type="text/javascript">

var $iframe = $("#customsheet-preview iframe");

var editors = {};

var existingStyle = false;

var _updatePreview = function() {
if($("#customsheet-preview").length < 1) return;

console.log("Update preview!");

if(!existingStyle) {
var head = $iframe.contents().find("head")[0];
existingStyle = $iframe.contents()[0].createElement('style');
if(existingStyle && head) head.appendChild(existingStyle);
}
var css = $("textarea[name=customcharsheet_style]").val();

var filterFunc = function(input, allowed) {
input = input.replace(/\/\*\s*start mobile\s*\*\/[\S\s]*?\/\*\s*end mobile\s*\*\//gi, ''); // remove mobile css
input = input.replace(/\/\*[^\*]+\*\//g, ""); //remove all css comments

//Look for selectors, make sure that they start with .char-sheet
input = input.replace(/([^{]+){[^}]*}/ig, function(match, selectors) {
selectors = $.trim(selectors);
var sarray = selectors.split(",");
var finalselector = "";
for(var i=0; i < sarray.length; i++) {
sarray[i] = $.trim(sarray[i]);
if(sarray[i].substring(0, 1) === "#") {
sarray[i] = sarray[i].replace("#", ".");
}
if(sarray[i].substring(0, 11) !== ".charsheet " && sarray[i] !== ".charsheet" && sarray[i] !== "@font-face" && sarray[i].substring(0, 20) !== ".sheet-rolltemplate-" && sarray[i].substring(0, 8) !== "@import ") {
sarray[i] = ".charsheet " + sarray[i];
}
}
finalselector = sarray.join(",");
match = match.replace(selectors, finalselector);
return match;
});

var evil = [
/(\bdata:\b|eval|cookie|\bwindow\b|\bparent\b|\bthis\b)/i, // suspicious javascript-type words
/behaviou?r|expression|moz-binding|@charset|javascript|vbscript|[\<]|\\\w/i,
/@import (?!url\(['"]https:\/\/fonts\.googleapis\.com\/css\?family=)/i,
///[\<>]/, // back slash, html tags,
/[\x7f-\xff]/, // high bytes -- suspect
/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F]/, //low bytes -- suspect
/&\#/, // bad charset
];

for(var i=0; i < evil.length; i++) {
if(input.match(evil[i])) {
console.error("Potential CSS security violation; character sheet template styling thrown out.");
input = "";
}
}

input = input.replace(/url[\s]*\([^\)]+\)/ig, function(match) {
match = match.replace(/\s/gi, ""); //replace all whitespace.
match = match.replace("url(", "");
var ps = match.split(")");
match = ps[ps.length - 2]; //everything before last parentheses
match = match.replace(/'/ig, "");
match = match.replace(/"/ig, ""); //remove all quotes/apostrophes
//At this point it should just be the URL.
var noproxy = ["https://s3.amazonaws.com/files.d20.io", "https://app.roll20.net/images/"];
for(let i=0; i<noproxy.length; i++){
if(match.substring(0, noproxy[i].length) === noproxy[i]) {
return `url("${match}")`;
}
};
if(/^https?:\/\//.test(match)) {
return "url('https://imgsrv.roll20.net/?src=" + escape($.trim(match)) + "')";
}
else {
return "";
}
});

// input = input.replace(/url[\s]*\([\s]*(?<url>[^\)]*)[\s]*\)[\s]*/ig, function(match) {
// console.log(match);
// });

allowed = (((allowed || "") + "").toLowerCase().match(/<[a-z][a-z0-9]*>/g) || []).join(''); // making sure the allowed arg is a string containing only tags in lowercase (<a><b><c>)
var tags = /<\/?([a-z][a-z0-9]*)\b[^>]*>/gi,
commentsAndPhpTags = /<!--[\s\S]*?-->|<\?(?:php)?[\s\S]*?\?>/gi;
return input.replace(commentsAndPhpTags, '').replace(tags, function ($0, $1) {
return allowed.indexOf('<' + $1.toLowerCase() + '>') > -1 ? $0 : '';
});

};

css = filterFunc(css);

if (existingStyle.styleSheet){
existingStyle.styleSheet.cssText = css;
} else {
while(existingStyle.firstChild) {
existingStyle.removeChild(existingStyle.firstChild);
}
existingStyle.appendChild(document.createTextNode(css));
}

var html = $("textarea[name=customcharsheet_layout]").val();

var filterFunc = function (input, allowed, ignoreadvanced) {
// Remove anything in <mobile> tags
input = input.replace(/<mobile\s*>[\s\S]*?<\/mobile\s*>|<\/*web\s*>|<\/*mobile\s*>/g, '');
// Strips HTML and PHP tags from a string
if(!ignoreadvanced && allowed !== undefined) {
input = html_sanitize(
input,
function(url) {
var match = url.toString();
var noproxy = ["https://s3.amazonaws.com/files.d20.io", "https://app.roll20.net/images/"];
for(let i=0; i<noproxy.length; i++){
if(match.substring(0, noproxy[i].length) === noproxy[i]) {
return match;
}
};
if(/^https?:\/\//.test(match)) {
return "https://imgsrv.roll20.net/?src=" + escape(match);
}
else {
return "";
}
},
function(groupid) {
var classes = groupid.split(" ");
_.each(classes, function(id, idx) {
if(id.substring(0, 5) === "attr_" || id.substring(0,6) === "sheet-" || id.substring(0, 10) === "repeating_" || id.substring(0, 5) === "roll_" || id.substring(0, 4) === "act_") {
classes[idx] = id;
}
else {
classes[idx] = "sheet-" + id;
}
});
return classes.join(" ");
}
);
};
allowed = (((allowed || "") + "").toLowerCase().match(/<[a-z][a-z0-9]*>/g) || []).join(''); // making sure the allowed arg is a string containing only tags in lowercase (<a><b><c>)
var tags = /<\/?([a-z][a-z0-9]*)\b[^>]*>/gi,
commentsAndPhpTags = /<!--[\s\S]*?-->|<\?(?:php)?[\s\S]*?\?>/gi;
return input.replace(commentsAndPhpTags, '').replace(tags, function ($0, $1) {
return allowed.indexOf('<' + $1.toLowerCase() + '>') > -1 ? $0 : '';
});
//return input;
};

html = filterFunc(html, "<br><input><textarea><div><span><label><hr><img><b><i><strong><em><h1><h2><h3><h4><h5><h6><p><hr><table><tr><td><tbody><thead><th><tfoot><select><option><optgroup><fieldset><button><ul><li><ol><caption>");

$iframe.contents().find("#root").html(html);

console.log("updated preview!");
}

var updatePreview = _.debounce(_updatePreview, 250);

$(".tab-content .editor").each(function() {
var $textarea = $("textarea[name=" + $(this).attr("data-target") + "]");
var editor = ace.edit(this);
editor.setTheme("ace/theme/monokai");
editor.setHighlightActiveLine(false);
editor.getSession().setUseWorker(false);

console.log($(this).attr("data-target"))

if($(this).attr("data-target").indexOf("layout") !== -1) {
editors.html = editor;
editor.getSession().setMode("ace/mode/html");
if(window.sheetlayout !== undefined) {
editor.getSession().setValue(BASE64.decode(window.sheetlayout));
}
}
else if($(this).attr("data-target").indexOf("style") !== -1) {
editors.css = editor;
editor.getSession().setMode("ace/mode/css");
if(window.sheetstyle !== undefined) {
editor.getSession().setValue(BASE64.decode(window.sheetstyle));
}
}
else if($(this).attr("data-target").indexOf("json") !== -1) {
editors.json = editor;
editor.getSession().setMode("ace/mode/json");
if(window.sheetjson !== undefined) {
editor.getSession().setValue(BASE64.decode(window.sheetjson));
}
}
else {
editors.translation = editor;
editor.getSession().setMode("ace/mode/json");
if(window.sheettranslation !== undefined) {
editor.getSession().setValue(BASE64.decode(window.sheettranslation));
}
}

$textarea.val(editor.getSession().getValue());

editor.getSession().on('change', function(){
$textarea.val(editor.getSession().getValue());
updatePreview();
UNSAVEDCHANGES = true;
});

setTimeout(function() {
updatePreview();
}, 0);
});

</script>

<script type="text/javascript">

function flippyTriangle($container) {
var $flippyTriangle = $container.find('.flippy-triangle');
var isOn = $flippyTriangle.hasClass('on');
$flippyTriangle.html(isOn ? '&#x25B8;' : '&#x25BE;').addClass(isOn ? 'off' : 'on').removeClass(isOn ? 'on' : 'off');
}

$(".gamedefaultsettings").on("click", function(e) {
$(".defaultoptions").toggleClass("hidden");
flippyTriangle($(".gamedefaultsettings"));
$(".grid_type").trigger("change");
$(".scale_units").trigger("change");

var checked = $(".compact_bar input[name='barStyle']:checked").val();
if(checked === "compact"){

$(".bar2_num_permission").attr("disabled", true);
$(".bar3_num_permission").attr("disabled", true);
}
});

});

else {

$feature_parent.attr("data-feature_enabled", checked);

if (checked) {

) {

})

$(".grid_type").on("change", (e) => {
let diagonalselect = $(".diagonaltype");
let hexonly = [
"hex",
];
let squareonly = [
"foure",
"threefive",
"manhattan",
];
let always_visible = [
"pythagorean",
];
let list_to_hide;

if(e.target.value === "square") {
list_to_hide = squareonly.concat(always_visible);
$(".gridlabels").parent().addClass("hidden");
}
else if(e.target.value === "dimetric" || e.target.value === 'isometric') {
// list_to_hide = squareonly.concat(always_visible);
$(".gridlabels").parent().addClass("hidden");
}
else if(e.target.value === "hex" || e.target.value === "hexr") {
list_to_hide = hexonly.concat(always_visible);
$(".gridlabels").parent().removeClass("hidden");
}

if((e.target.value === "square") && hexonly.indexOf(diagonalselect.val()) > -1) {
diagonalselect.children("option:selected").prop("selected", false);
diagonalselect.children("option[value='foure']").prop("selected", true);
}
else if((e.target.value === "dimetric" || e.target.value === 'isometric') && hexonly.indexOf(diagonalselect.val()) > -1 && squareonly.indexOf(diagonalselect.val()) > -1) {
diagonalselect.children("option:selected").prop("selected", false);
diagonalselect.children("option[value='foure']").prop("selected", true);
}
else if((e.target.value === "hex" || e.target.value === "hexr") && squareonly.indexOf(diagonalselect.val()) > -1) {
diagonalselect.children("option:selected").prop("selected", false);
diagonalselect.children("option[value='hex']").prop("selected", true);
}

if(e.target.value === "hexr") {
$("#cell_measurement").html(i18n("page_settings_cell_height","Cell Height"));
}
else {
$("#cell_measurement").html(i18n("page_settings_cell_width","Cell Width"));
};

diagonalselect.children().removeClass("hidden");
let to_hide = diagonalselect.children("option");
_.each(list_to_hide, (value) => to_hide = to_hide.not(`option[value=${value}]`));
to_hide.addClass("hidden");
});

$("a.savedefaults").on("click", function(e) {
if($(this).hasClass("disabled")) {
return;
};
$(this).addClass("disabled").text("Saving Defaults");

//defaults is passed into window.defaultsettings
var defaults = {};

//defaultsettings are set by campaignsettings.haml
if(!defaultsettings) {
defaultsettings = {};
}

if($(".width") && ($(".width").val() != 25 || defaultsettings["width"])) {defaults["width"] = $(".width").val()};
if($(".height") && ($(".height").val() != 25 || defaultsettings["height"])) {defaults["height"] = $(".height").val()};
if($(".scale_number") && ($(".scale_number").val() != 5 || defaultsettings["scale_number"])) {defaults["scale_number"] = $(".scale_number").val()};
if($(".scale_units") && ($(".scale_units").val() != "ft" || defaultsettings["scale_units"])) {defaults["scale_units"] = $(".scale_units").val() !== "custom" ? $(".scale_units").val() : $("#custom_scale_units > input").val()};
if($(".pagebackground") && ($(".pagebackground").spectrum('get').toHexString() != "#ffffff" || defaultsettings["background_color"])) {
// removed ternary statement for readibility
// Below is using the spectrum 'get' and the spectrum method to get the rgb value since using .val() comes in as a hex code as the default. Transparent comes in as rgba(0,0,0,0) and black comes in as rgb(0, 0, 0) and since their hex code is the same (#000000), using the rgb/rgba value is the only way to distinguish between the two. This solves the issue of transparent not saving after saving another color and choosing transparent again. The same goes for gridcolor and tint_color (see below)
if ($(".pagebackground").spectrum('get').toRgbString() === "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"){
defaults["background_color"] = "transparent"
} else {
defaults["background_color"] = $(".pagebackground").val();
}
}
if($(".wrappercolor") && ($(".wrappercolor").spectrum('get').toHexString() != "transparent" || defaultsettings["wrapperColor"])) {
if ($(".wrappercolor").spectrum('get').toRgbString() === "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"){
defaults["wrapperColor"] = "transparent"
} else {
defaults["wrapperColor"] = $(".wrappercolor").val();
}
}
if($(".useautowrapper") && $(".useautowrapper")[0] && ($(".useautowrapper")[0].checked === false || defaultsettings["useAutoWrapper"] === false)) {defaults["useAutoWrapper"] = $(".useautowrapper")[0].checked};
if($(".showgrid") && $(".showgrid")[0] && ($(".showgrid")[0].checked === false || defaultsettings["showgrid"] === false)) {defaults["showgrid"] = $(".showgrid")[0].checked};
if($(".snapping_increment") && ($(".snapping_increment").val() != 1 || defaultsettings["snapping_increment"])) {defaults["snapping_increment"] = $(".snapping_increment").val()};
if($(".diagonaltype") && ($(".diagonaltype").val() != "foure" || defaultsettings["diagonaltype"])) {defaults["diagonaltype"] = $(".diagonaltype").val()};
if($(".grid_type") && ($(".grid_type").val() != "square" || defaultsettings["grid_type"])) {defaults["grid_type"] = $(".grid_type").val()};
if($(".gridlabels") && $(".gridlabels")[0] && ($(".gridlabels")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["gridlabels"])) {defaults["gridlabels"] = $(".gridlabels")[0].checked};
if($("#gridcolor") && ($("#gridcolor").val() != "#c0c0c0" || defaultsettings["gridcolor"])) {
if($("#gridcolor").spectrum('get').toRgbString() === "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"){
defaults["gridcolor"] = "transparent"
}else{
defaults["gridcolor"] = $("#gridcolor").val();
}
}
if($(".grid_opacity") && ($(".grid_opacity").val() != 0.5 || defaultsettings["grid_opacity"])) {defaults["grid_opacity"] = $(".grid_opacity").val()};
if($(".showdarkness") && $(".showdarkness")[0] && ($(".showdarkness")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["showdarkness"])) {defaults["showdarkness"] = $(".showdarkness")[0].checked};
if($(".advancedfowenabled") && $(".advancedfowenabled")[0] && ($(".advancedfowenabled")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["adv_fow_enabled"])) {defaults["adv_fow_enabled"] = $(".advancedfowenabled")[0].checked};
if($(".adv_fow_grid_size") && ($(".adv_fow_grid_size").val() != 1 || defaultsettings["adv_fow_grid_size"])) {defaults["adv_fow_grid_size"] = $(".adv_fow_grid_size").val()};
if($(".advancedfowshowgrid") && $(".advancedfowshowgrid")[0] && ($(".advancedfowshowgrid")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["adv_fow_show_grid"])) {defaults["adv_fow_show_grid"] = $(".advancedfowshowgrid")[0].checked};
if($(".dimlightreveals") && $(".dimlightreveals")[0] && ($(".dimlightreveals")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["adv_fow_dim_reveals"])) {defaults["adv_fow_dim_reveals"] = $(".dimlightreveals")[0].checked};
if($("#afow_gm_see_all") && $("#afow_gm_see_all")[0] && ($("#afow_gm_see_all")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["adv_fow_gm_see_all"])) {defaults["adv_fow_gm_see_all"] = $("#afow_gm_see_all")[0].checked};
if($(".showlighting") && $(".showlighting")[0] && ($(".showlighting")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["showlighting"])) {defaults["showlighting"] = $(".showlighting")[0].checked};
if($(".lightenforcelos") && $(".lightenforcelos")[0] && ($(".lightenforcelos")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["lightenforcelos"])) {defaults["lightenforcelos"] = $(".lightenforcelos")[0].checked};
if($(".dyn_fog_enabled") && $(".dyn_fog_enabled").prop("checked")) {
if ($(".dyn_fog_update_on_drop") && $(".dyn_fog_update_on_drop").val() != "" || defaultsettings["lightupdatedrop"]) {
defaults["lightupdatedrop"] = $(".dyn_fog_update_on_drop").prop("checked")
}
} else {
if($(".lightupdatedrop") && $(".lightupdatedrop")[0] && ($(".lightupdatedrop")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["lightupdatedrop"])) {
defaults["lightupdatedrop"] = $(".lightupdatedrop")[0].checked
}
}
if($(".lightrestrictmove") && $(".lightrestrictmove")[0] && ($(".lightrestrictmove")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["lightrestrictmove"])) {defaults["lightrestrictmove"] = $(".lightrestrictmove")[0].checked};
if($(".lightglobalillum") && $(".lightglobalillum")[0] && ($(".lightglobalillum")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["lightglobalillum"])) {defaults["lightglobalillum"] = $(".lightglobalillum")[0].checked};
if($(".fog_opacity_new_light") && ($(".fog_opacity_new_light").val() != 0.35 || defaultsettings["fog_opacity"])) {
if($(".dyn_fog_enabled").prop("checked")){
defaults["fog_opacity"] = $(".fog_opacity_new_light").val() ;
}
else{
defaults["fog_opacity"] = $(".fog_opacity_leg").val()
}
};
if($(".aura1_square") && $(".aura1_square")[0] && ($(".aura1_square")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["aura1_square"])) {defaults["aura1_square"] = $(".aura1_square")[0].checked};
if($(".aura1_radius") && ($(".aura1_radius").val() != "" || defaultsettings["aura1_radius"])) {defaults["aura1_radius"] = $(".aura1_radius").val()};
if($(".aura1_color") && ($(".aura1_color").val() != "#ffff99" || defaultsettings["aura1_color"])) {defaults["aura1_color"] = $(".aura1_color").val()};
if($(".aura2_square") && $(".aura2_square")[0] && ($(".aura2_square")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["aura2_square"])) {defaults["aura2_square"] = $(".aura2_square")[0].checked === true};
if($(".aura2_radius") && ($(".aura2_radius").val() != "" || defaultsettings["aura2_radius"])) {defaults["aura2_radius"] = $(".aura2_radius").val()};
if($(".aura2_color") && ($(".aura2_color").val() != "#59e594" || defaultsettings["aura2_color"])) {defaults["aura2_color"] = $(".aura2_color").val()};
if($(".tint_color") && ($(".tint_color").val() != "transparent" || defaultsettings["tint_color"])) {
if($(".tint_color").spectrum('get').toRgbString() === "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"){
defaults["tint_color"] = "transparent"
}else{
defaults["tint_color"] = $(".tint_color").val();
}
}
if($(".showname") && $(".showname")[0] && ($(".showname")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["showname"])) {defaults["showname"] = $(".showname")[0].checked};
if($(".showplayers_name") && $(".showplayers_name")[0] && ($(".showplayers_name")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["showplayers_name"])) {defaults["showplayers_name"] = $(".showplayers_name")[0].checked};
if($(".playersedit_name") && $(".playersedit_name")[0] && ($(".playersedit_name")[0].checked === false || defaultsettings["playersedit_name"] === false)) {defaults["playersedit_name"] = $(".playersedit_name")[0].checked};
if($(".showplayers_aura1") && $(".showplayers_aura1")[0] && ($(".showplayers_aura1")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["showplayers_aura1"])) {defaults["showplayers_aura1"] = $(".showplayers_aura1")[0].checked === true};
if($(".playersedit_aura1") && $(".playersedit_aura1")[0] && ($(".playersedit_aura1")[0].checked === false || defaultsettings["playersedit_aura1"] === false)) {defaults["playersedit_aura1"] = $(".playersedit_aura1")[0].checked};
if($(".showplayers_aura2") && $(".showplayers_aura2")[0] && ($(".showplayers_aura2")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["showplayers_aura2"])) {defaults["showplayers_aura2"] = $(".showplayers_aura2")[0].checked};
if($(".playersedit_aura2") && $(".playersedit_aura2")[0] && ($(".playersedit_aura2")[0].checked === false || defaultsettings["playersedit_aura2"] === false)) {defaults["playersedit_aura2"] = $(".playersedit_aura2")[0].checked};
if($(".light_radius") && ($(".light_radius").val() != "" || defaultsettings["light_radius"])) {defaults["light_radius"] = $(".light_radius").val()};
if($(".light_dimradius") && ($(".light_dimradius").val() != "" || defaultsettings["light_dimradius"])) {defaults["light_dimradius"] = $(".light_dimradius").val()};
if($(".light_angle") && ($(".light_angle").val() != "" || defaultsettings["light_angle"])) {defaults["light_angle"] = $(".light_angle").val()};
if($(".light_otherplayers") && $(".light_otherplayers")[0] && ($(".light_otherplayers")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["light_otherplayers"])) {defaults["light_otherplayers"] = $(".light_otherplayers")[0].checked};
if($(".light_hassight") && $(".light_hassight")[0] && ($(".light_hassight")[0].checked === true || defaultsettings["light_hassight"])) {defaults["light_hassight"] = $(".light_hassight")[0].checked};
if($(".light_losangle") && ($(".light_losangle").val() != "" || defaultsettings["light_losangle"])) {defaults["light_losangle"] = $(".light_losangle").val()};
if($(".light_multiplier") && ($(".light_multiplier").val() != "" || defaultsettings["light_multiplier"])) {defaults["light_multiplier"] = $(".light_multiplier").val()};
if($(".advfow_viewdistance") && ($(".advfow_viewdistance").val() != "" || defaultsettings["adv_fow_view_distance"])) {defaults["adv_fow_view_distance"] = $(".advfow_viewdistance").val()};
if($(".bar_location") && ($(".bar_location").val() != "above" || defaultsettings["bar_location"])) {defaults["bar_location"] = $(".bar_location").val()};
if($(".compact_bar input[name='barStyle']") && ($(".compact_bar input[name='barStyle']:checked").val() != "standard" || defaultsettings["compact_bar"])) {defaults["compact_bar"] = $(".compact_bar input[name='barStyle']:checked").val()};

// Updated Dynamic Lighting page settings
if ($(".dyn_fog_enabled") && $(".dyn_fog_enabled").val() != "" || defaultsettings["dynamic_lighting_enabled"]) { defaults["dynamic_lighting_enabled"] = $(".dyn_fog_enabled").prop("checked") }
if ($(".dyn_fog_global_illum") && $(".dyn_fog_global_illum").val() != "" || defaultsettings["daylight_mode_enabled"]) { defaults["daylight_mode_enabled"] = $(".dyn_fog_global_illum").prop("checked") }
if ($(".dyn_fog_autofog_mode") && $(".dyn_fog_autofog_mode").val() != "" || defaultsettings["explorer_mode"]) { $(".dyn_fog_autofog_mode").prop("checked") ? defaults["explorer_mode"] = "basic" : defaults["explorer_mode"] = "off" }
// Updated Dynamic Lighting token settings
// Vision (includes both bright-light and low-light)
const has_vision = $(".dyn_fog_emits_vision") ? $(".dyn_fog_emits_vision").prop("checked") : false;
if (has_vision !== !!defaultsettings["has_bright_light_vision"]) {
defaults["has_bright_light_vision"] = has_vision;
defaults["has_low_light_vision"] = has_vision;
}else {
defaults["has_bright_light_vision"] = defaultsettings["has_bright_light_vision"];
defaults["has_low_light_vision"] = defaultsettings["has_bright_light_vision"];
}
// Nightvision
if ($(".dyn_fog_emits_dark_vision") && $(".dyn_fog_emits_dark_vision").val() != "" || defaultsettings["has_night_vision"]) { defaults["has_night_vision"] = $(".dyn_fog_emits_dark_vision").prop("checked")}
// Nightvision range
if ($(".dyn_fog_dark_vision_range") && $(".dyn_fog_dark_vision_range").val() != "" || defaultsettings["night_vision_distance"]) { defaults["night_vision_distance"] = $(".dyn_fog_dark_vision_range").val()}
// Nightvision Color
if($(".dyn_fog_dark_vision_color") && ($(".dyn_fog_dark_vision_color").val() != "#ffff99" || defaultsettings["night_vision_tint"])) {defaults["night_vision_tint"] = $(".dyn_fog_dark_vision_color").val()};
// Nightvision effect
const nv_effect = $(".dyn_fog_dark_vision_effect").val();
if(nv_effect === "Dimming") {
const dimming_start = $(".dyn_fog_dark_vision_effect_dimming").val() || 0;
const night_vision_range = $(".dyn_fog_dark_vision_range").val() || 0;
defaults['night_vision_effect'] = `${nv_effect}_${dimming_start / night_vision_range}`;
} else {
defaults['night_vision_effect'] = nv_effect || null;
}

// Field of vision
const has_limit_fov = $(".dyn_fog_field_of_vision") ? $(".dyn_fog_field_of_vision").prop("checked") : false;
if (has_limit_fov !== !!defaultsettings["has_limit_field_of_vision"]) {
defaults["has_limit_field_of_vision"] = has_limit_fov;
defaults["has_limit_field_of_night_vision"] = has_limit_fov;
} else {
defaults["has_limit_field_of_vision"] = defaultsettings["has_limit_field_of_vision"];
defaults["has_limit_field_of_night_vision"] = defaultsettings["has_limit_field_of_night_vision"];
}
if ($(".field_of_vision_total") && $(".field_of_vision_total").val() != "" || defaultsettings["limit_field_of_vision_total"]) {
defaults["limit_field_of_vision_total"] = $(".field_of_vision_total").val();
defaults["limit_field_of_night_vision_total"] = $(".field_of_vision_total").val();
}
if ($(".field_of_vision_center") && $(".field_of_vision_center").val() != "" || defaultsettings["limit_field_of_vision_center"]) {
defaults["limit_field_of_vision_center"] = $(".field_of_vision_center").val();
defaults["limit_field_of_night_vision_center"] = $(".field_of_vision_center").val()
}
// Emits bright light
if ($(".dyn_fog_emits_light") && $(".dyn_fog_emits_light").val() != "" || defaultsettings["emits_bright_light"]) { defaults["emits_bright_light"] = $(".dyn_fog_emits_light").prop("checked")}
// Bright light range
if ($(".dyn_fog_light_range") && $(".dyn_fog_light_range").val() != "" || defaultsettings["bright_light_distance"]) { defaults["bright_light_distance"] = $(".dyn_fog_light_range").val()}
// Emits low light
if ($(".dyn_fog_emits_dim_light") && $(".dyn_fog_emits_dim_light").val() != "" || defaultsettings["emits_low_light"]) { defaults["emits_low_light"] = $(".dyn_fog_emits_dim_light").prop("checked")}
// Low light range (as seen in UI)
if ($(".dyn_fog_dim_light_range") && $(".dyn_fog_dim_light_range").val() != "" || defaultsettings["light_ui"]) { defaults["light_ui"] = $(".dyn_fog_dim_light_range").val()}
const lowLightBrightnessDefault = ("dim_light_opacity" in defaultsettings) ? defaultsettings["dim_light_opacity"] : 0.75;
const lowLightBrightnessSlider = $(".dyn_fog_dim_light_opacity");
if (lowLightBrightnessSlider && lowLightBrightnessSlider.val() !== lowLightBrightnessDefault) {
defaults["dim_light_opacity"] = lowLightBrightnessSlider.val();
}
// Directional Light
const has_directional_light = $(".dyn_fog_field_of_light") ? $(".dyn_fog_field_of_light").prop("checked") : false;
if (has_directional_light !== !!defaultsettings["has_directional_bright_light"]) {
defaults["has_directional_bright_light"] = has_directional_light;
defaults["has_directional_dim_light"] = has_directional_light;
} else {
defaults["has_directional_bright_light"] = defaultsettings["has_directional_bright_light"];
defaults["has_directional_dim_light"] = defaultsettings["has_directional_dim_light"];
}
if ($(".field_of_light_total") && $(".field_of_light_total").val() != "" || defaultsettings["directional_bright_light_total"]) {
defaults["directional_bright_light_total"] = $(".field_of_light_total").val();
defaults["directional_dim_light_total"] = $(".field_of_light_total").val();
}
if ($(".field_of_light_center") && $(".field_of_light_center").val() != "" || defaultsettings["directional_dim_light_total"]) {
defaults["directional_bright_light_center"] = $(".field_of_light_center").val();
defaults["directional_dim_light_center"] = $(".field_of_light_center").val()
}

//Light Multiplier
if ($(".light_multi_input") && $(".light_multi_input").val() !== "" || defaultsettings["light_sensitivity_multiplier"]) {
defaults["light_sensitivity_multiplier"] = $(".light_multi_input").val();
}

//Legacy Settings
if ($(".legacy_set") && $("#toggle_proxy > input" ).prop('checked') !== false || defaultsettings["legacy_lighting_enabled"]) {
defaults["legacy_lighting_enabled"] = $("#toggle_proxy > input" ).prop('checked');
}

// Check for strings that are supposed to be numbers
for ([defaultKey, defaultValue] of Object.entries(defaults)) {
if (typeof defaultValue === "string" && (Number(defaultValue) || Number(defaultValue) === 0)) {
defaults[defaultKey] = Number(defaultValue)
}
}
// low_light_distance is the value of light_ui + bright_light_distance
// It is not the value of the user input labelled Low Light Distance that is light_ui
if ($(".dyn_fog_dim_light_range") && $(".dyn_fog_dim_light_range").val() != "" || defaultsettings["low_light_distance"]) { defaults["low_light_distance"] = defaults["light_ui"] + defaults["bright_light_distance"]}

for(let i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) {
let bar_defaults;
bar_defaults = {
[`bar${i}_value`]: "",
[`bar${i}_max`]: "",
[`bar${i}_num_permission`]: "editors",
[`showplayers_bar${i}`]: false,
[`playersedit_bar${i}`]: true,
};
const input_names = [
`bar${i}_value`,
`bar${i}_max`,
`bar${i}_num_permission`,
];
for(const name of input_names) {
const input = $("." + name);
if(input && input.val() !== bar_defaults[name]) {
defaults[name] = input.val();
}
}

const checkbox_names = [
`showplayers_bar${i}`,
`playersedit_bar${i}`,
];
for(const name of checkbox_names) {
const input = $("." + name);
if(input && input[0] && input[0].checked !== bar_defaults[name]) {
defaults[name] = input[0].checked;
}
}
}

<div class="avatar dropbox <$! (this != "" ? "filled" : "empty") $>">
<div class="status"></div>
<div class="inner">
<$ if(this == "") { $>
<h4 style="padding-bottom: 0px; marigin-bottom: 0px; color: #777;">Drop a File<small>(JPG, PNG, GIF)</small></h4>
<div style="margin-top: -5px; margin-bottom: 5px;">or</div>
<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="btn btn-info" style="margin-bottom: 10px;">Choose a File...</a>
<input class="manual" type="file" />
<$ } else { $>
<img src="<$!this$>" />
<div class='remove'><a href='javascript:void(0);'>Change Image</a></div>
<$ } $>
</div>
</div>
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
$(function() {
var cookieName = "roll20tempauth";
var cookieValue = Math.floor(Math.random()*100);
var myDate = new Date();
myDate.setMonth(myDate.getMonth() + 1);
var cookieinfo = cookieName +"=" + cookieValue + ";expires=" + myDate + ";domain=.roll20.net;path=/";
document.cookie = cookieinfo;
});
</script>



<script type="text/javascript">
$("#roll20-top .loginform button").on("click", function() {
console.log("click");
var $form = $(this).parents("form");
$form.attr("action", $form.attr("action") + "?backto=" + escape(window.location));
$form.submit();
return false;
});

$(".topbarnotifications .notification button").on("click", function() {
let notid = $(this).attr("data-notification-id");
let othis = this;
$.getJSON("https://app.roll20.net/notifications/dismiss/" + notid + "/?callback=?", function(data) {
if(notid == "all") {
$(othis).parents(".notifications").fadeOut();
$(".alertcount").html("");
$(".topbarnotifications .alertcontainer").html("<a href='https://app.roll20.net/private_message/inbox/' class='btn btn-default pictos' role='button' style='color:#555'>M</a>")
return;
}
if($(othis).attr("href")) {
window.location = "https://app.roll20.net" + $(othis).attr("href");
}
else {
$(othis).parents(".notification").fadeOut();
let $count = $(othis).parents(".notifications").find("a .count");
let current = parseInt($.trim($count.text()), 10);
current = current - 1;
if(current < 0) current = 0;
$count.text(current);
countdown = parseInt($(".alertcount").html(), 10)
$(".alertcount").html(countdown - 1);
if(countdown < 2) {
$(othis).parents(".notifications").fadeOut();
$(".alertcount").html("");
$(".topbarnotifications .alertcontainer").html("<a href='https://app.roll20.net/private_message/inbox/' class='btn btn-default pictos' role='button' style='color:#555'>M</a>")
return;
}
}
});
return false;
});

$(".topbarsitenotifications .newalerts button").on("click", function() {
if($(this).parent().hasClass("newalerts")) {
$(this).parent().removeClass("newalerts");
$.getJSON("https://app.roll20.net/account/update_last_notification/?callback=?", function(data) {});
}
});

$(".topbarsitenotifications .sitenotifications button.fetch_more_notifications").on("click", function() {
window.location = "https://app.roll20.net/sitenotifications";
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
